schedule.wrapper_calendar_refresh: runs before the 08:30 decision clock; one 30-second capture per required calendar year, at most two years during the New Year lookback
schedule.wrapper_waits_for: Asia/Taipei 08:30 natural decision clock; five minutes from an on-time 08:25 trigger
schedule.late_start_policy: blocked after Asia/Taipei 08:35; no catch-up credit

principal.resolution_rule: At deployment, re-query the existing Paper Portfolio task and abort on principal/SID mismatch; do not hard-code a different account.

settings.reason: The timezone-aware trigger leaves five minutes until Taipei 08:30. Preserve the already configured PT2H outer limit without guessing a shorter duration; the wrapper still enforces the 08:35 ML deadline.

preconditions: The exact forward child contract is accepted: full outer payload, nested daily_orchestration.natural_forward_completion_clock, outer failure status takes precedence.
The daily producer has an offline verified official calendar cache and one-session freshness policy; unknown calendar or stale archive fails closed.
The V2 release root and manifest hash above pass a fresh readback; replacement blocks before child start.
The existing baldr-ml-allocation-copilot-daily 05:20 catch-up task remains unchanged.
Update only the exact existing root task after a successful readback; query errors or a missing task fail closed and do not permit creation or replacement.
deployment_sequence: Query the exact existing root task and save its before XML, enabled state, principal and settings before editing.
Run run_ml_allocation_forward_daily.cmd preflight and verify V2 release hash, repo output paths, calendar cache and wrapper parser tests; this mode never waits or runs the producer/child.
Update the existing task definition in place from ml_forward_task_registration.xml; do not create a new task or replace its principal/ACL.

Query the exact root task and export after XML; verify the aware 08:25 +08:00 trigger, zero RandomDelay, exact action/repository working directory, preserved enabled state, InteractiveToken principal, IgnoreNew, PT2H, battery restrictions, StartWhenAvailable=false and WakeToRun=false.
Do not invoke the wrapper as a production forward run during registration; do not register if the archive/config/frozen release gate is not ready.

prior_registration_evidence.verification: Historical readback for the prior 16:15 Pacific trigger; it does not verify the prepared 08:25 +08:00 update. The task had never run at that readback and no forward child was launched during that registration.

rollback.method: Re-register the saved before XML at the same exact root task path, then read back its original trigger/settings and enabled state.
rollback.condition: This operation updates an existing task; do not delete the task as rollback.
rollback.evidence: Save rollback registration result and post-rollback XML/query before declaring rollback complete.

safety.notes: This plan prepares a candidate-only shadow caller. It does not grant formal OOS credit, production alpha, or broker access.
